name: Calor's Note
summary: In Duskwood, Calor's Note carries a woodsman's recommendation to Master Jonathan Carevin. Calor writes it on a scrap of faded parchment for a tested adventurer, opening a path to a hidden band that fights beside Darkshire's militia but remains apart from it.

sections.title: A Rare Recommendation
sections.body: Calor is notoriously hard to impress, and Duskwood offers strangers little warmth. When an adventurer survives the bloodthirsty worgen stalking the woods, Calor's respect is earned, and he writes a brief message. The faded note travels to Darkshire, where it introduces the outsider directly to Jonathan Carevin.

sections.title: A Private Crusade
sections.body: Darkshire relies on the Night Watch for public defense, while Calor and Carevin pursue a grimmer, hidden fight. Calor laments that the town guard outnumbers them and hopes to find enough capable fighters to advance their private war. When the note is handed over, it grants entry to Carevin's campaign against demons, undead, and the hidden sympathizers aiding Duskwood's decline.

faq.answer: Calor's Note is a handwritten message from Calor on a scrap of faded parchment. It recommends an adventurer as capable and reliable against Duskwood's horrors.

aliases: who do i give the note to
faq.answer: The note is addressed to Jonathan Carevin, a stern figure stationed in Darkshire who coordinates an effort against the dark forces threatening the region.

faq.q: How does Calor regard the Night Watch?
aliases: why does calor want to outnumber night watch
faq.answer: Calor believes the Night Watch cannot meet the true threats in Duskwood. As he hands over the note, he says he wants to recruit enough capable allies to outnumber the militia and finish the urgent work his small faction carries on alone.

faq.q: What kind of battle does Jonathan Carevin fight?
faq.answer: Master Carevin fights demons, the undead, and mortal collaborators who aid them in Duskwood. He values vigilance and devotion to the Holy Light, and accepts only proven people into his confidence.

angles.text: Jonathan Carevin greets the bearer with 'Glory under the Light,' a sign of shared ideals with holy warriors committed to cleansing Duskwood of demons and undead.
With the Stormwind army absent from Duskwood, Carevin's circle and the Night Watch are unofficial factions guarding the southern border against darkness.
